verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents search across filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content. It applies fuzzy matching to filenames and symbols, and supports regular-expression search when the pattern is wrapped in slashes, but regex only works in the file scope and filters are never explicitly described. missing for 10: documented search filters or scope options beyond the passing 'file scope' mention, regex search beyond the file scope, fuzzy matching for text content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and navigate code content using fuzzy matching, filters, and regular expressions

citations.quote: Search queries will be matched against filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content. For filenames and symbols a fuzzy matching will be performed
Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/ to find all integers.
